profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with 10+ years of experience in VR training, simulation and enterprise software for DoD and commercial clients. Skilled in C++, C#, and Unreal Engine, with a track record of leading teams, driving adoption of modern practices, and delivering customer-focused solutions. Passionate about leveraging technology to create immersive, effective, and scalable applications.

My passion is serious games, training simulations and VR/MR applications.

positions.title: Game Programmer
positions.description: I work on SIMVANA, a suite of VR Unreal Engine medical training simulations. My role is to design and implement application features through Blueprint and C++. I have shipped two highly regarded products during my time here, including SIMVANA Anesthesia (VR training app used by CRNA students at various universities around the globe) and SIMVANA Nursing (VR training app used to onboard nurses at various hospitals across Alabama). I have helped author almost 200 unique scenarios, optimized our shipping builds' by reducing frame hitches and loading times (in some cases up to 20% improvement), and regularly meet with subject matter experts and our customers to ensure accuracy of our lessons and identify areas to improve. Please check out https://simvana.com to see examples of our work.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led small teams of developers through software lifecycle using agile methodology
- Pioneered team towards test-driven development and proper API documentation practices
- Researched and leveraged 3D/VR technologies to develop training/simulation applications
- Engage with and observed customers in production environments to elicit requirements
- Demonstrated finished products to VIPs
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Qt · Unreal Engine 4 · Angular

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Converted existing driver dispatching application built on ASP.NET WebForms to new, bleeding-edge Azure Service Fabric technology while providing support to the old version

-Updated native Android phone application to new version to leverage new permissions features

-Gathered requirements for, designed, developed and supported PowerShell deployment scripts to ease the workflow of building and deploying Service Fabric apps for the systems team

-Designed, developed and supported new features for Service Fabric app to be compliant with new medical regulations prior to strict government deadline

positions.title: Software Consultant I
positions.description:
(Began working here once CGI acquired CTS through a merger.)

Client Projects:

-Alfa Insurance: Provided support and quality assurance for several in-house web applications; created test-plans, logged bugs, wrote automated testing scripts, and executed manual tests

-Southern Company: Provided on-call support for hundreds of in-house applications spanning technologies from .NET (ASP, MVC, WPF) to AngularJS, NodeJS, ReactJS, and SQL Server.

positions.title: Analyst I
positions.description:
Client Projects:

-CTS, Inc: Gathered requirements for, designed and developed a .NET MVC application for managers to organize and track employees and departments; SQL Server backend

-Lampo / Ramsey Solutions: Designed and developed a web application to centralize a token distribution service; Ruby on Rails frontend, Java backend; utilized agile methodology and TDD

-Lampo / Ramsey Solutions: Gathered requirements for, designed, developed and supported a storefront web application; Adobe Experience Manager frontend, Java backend

-Southern Company: Provided on-call support for hundreds of in-house applications spanning technologies from .NET (ASP, MVC, WPF) to AngularJS, NodeJS, ReactJS, and SQL Server

positions.title: R&D Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for writing and maintaining HIPAA compliant software systems throughout the complete software development life-cycle.

Responsible for quality assurance of software at various stages in development.

Worked primarily with string manipulation and PDF file processing in Visual C#.

Linked is my GitHub contributions page for the various open source projects I have worked on to date, from the trivial homework problems to serious endeavors.

projects.title: Mobile Howitzer Training Simulation
projects.description: Developed a 3D virtual reality training simulation for soldiers learning how to operate a mobile howitzer. Final product included the ability to measure time between shots so the team could work towards improving efficiency. Technologies leveraged included Unreal Engine 4, Unreal Blueprints, C++, and HTC Vive.

organizations.name: USA Programming Competition Team
organizations.description: Practiced and competed on a 3-man team. We have competed in every ACM International Collegiate Programming Competition since 2012 and every Deloitte Programming Competition at Hattiesburg since 2013. Our team placed 3rd at the 2013 ACM Southeast Regional ICPC, 2nd Division. We compete using Java.

organizations.name: USA Video Game Development Club
organizations.description: Founding member and VP. Assisted the other officers in drafting the club's bylaws, finding a sponsor, and gaining SGA support. Collaborated with a team of other student game developers to design and develop a video game using Unity 3D during the organization's first active year.
